decisions.reason: As a low-risk complement to the core flooring business, the cleaning soap likely remains because there is no sign of performance falling below aspiration and the firm appears to have enough slack to support a full care system.
The maintenance oil fits the firm's established wood-floor maintenance offer closely, so absent evidence of a clear shortfall management would likely keep it as part of the branded system solution.
This care product serves a somewhat narrower segment of oiled floors, but the firm's growth, hiring, and innovation activity suggest enough slack to keep it while demand becomes clearer.
A moisture-protection underlay supports installation performance and complements the core flooring range, making retention likely unless results clearly disappoint, which is not indicated here.
High-density underlay foam is a useful but somewhat more replaceable accessory, so its drop risk is a bit higher, yet management would still likely keep it given portfolio fit and available slack.

The oak parquet floor is close to the firm's core offer and strategic direction, and in a growing industry a mature German producer would usually keep such a new line unless early results were plainly below aspiration.
